function.description:
Execute a shell command and capture stdout, stderr, exit code, duration, and timeout status. Pipes and redirections are supported.

Set timeout_seconds for every command; values below the enforced 60-second minimum are raised automatically. Use cwd instead of cd.
function.name: bash

description.description: Brief label for this command shown in the status header and TUI (5-10 words)

timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait (minimum 60; values below 60 are raised automatically)
